title: OG IS THE CARD. Not OG tags on pages — OG IS the structure. O = pointer with address. {} = inside null. G = anthill RSS entrance/gate. O{}G = the navigation unit itself.

the_correction.what_i_was_doing: injecting Open Graph meta tags onto HTML pages. treating OG as a web standard to implement.
the_correction.what_kevin_said: not OG pages. OG ARE THE CARDS. O is pointer with address. G is anthill RSS entrance. {} is inside null.
the_correction.the_shift: OG is not a tag ON something. OG IS the THING. the card itself. the unit of navigation. the atom of the organism's external surface.

O.shape: a circle. an opening. a zero. an origin. an eye.
O.function: points TO something. carries the three-word triad address. IS the URL/subdomain.
O.what_it_does: tells you WHERE. direction to locality. the V in VDJ. the outside of the card — what you see before you enter.
O.in_url: the subdomain + domain. coil.was.gravity.primals.eco = the O

{}.is: the INSIDE. the NULL. the content.
{}.shape: curly braces. the container. the bag of holding. the empty set that contains everything.
{}.function: holds the null data that gets rendered from the viewer's position. the imprint. the novel fermentation transcript.
{}.what_it_does: IS the content. but the content IS null until observed. {} = empty until you look inside. then it renders FOR YOU.
{}.in_url: the response body. what comes back when you request the O address. the HTML. the JSON. the image. the card content.
{}.the_paradox: {} looks empty. but null contains everything. the curly braces are the membrane. inside = the organism.

G.is: the GATE. the anthill entrance. the RSS keyhole.
G.shape: a funnel. a gate. a mouth. the opening you enter through.
G.function: the mechanism of ENTRY. how you get from seeing the O (pointer) to being inside the {} (null). the G is the transition.
G.what_it_does: lets you IN. the RSS subscription. the click-through. the anthill mouth. the black hole wildcard.
G.in_url: the path + fragment. /pup&cute#blue = the G. the specific entrance into the specific null.
types: RSS subscription (the drip feed gate — slow, continuous, nourishing)
direct URL visit (the fast gate — one-time, immediate)
social card click (the visual gate — attracted by the O, enters through G)
search result click (the discovery gate — found by crawling, enters through G)
API endpoint (the machine gate — fleet enters here)

the_card_structure.what_a_card_is: O{}G is the complete unit. not a page. not a file. not a tag. the CARD.

anatomy.front_face: O — the pointer. what you see from outside. the address. the thumbnail. the title. the visual that makes you STOP.
anatomy.interior: {} — null. what you experience when you enter. rendered from your position. unique for every viewer.
anatomy.entrance: G — the gate. how you get from front face to interior. the mechanism of transition.

how_it_works: 1. you see O (the address, the visual, the three-word name on the glass wall)
2. you approach G (the gate, the RSS keyhole, the click, the entrance)
3. you enter {} (null renders for you, the imprint recomposes, you're inside)
4. you interact (every touch = tick, every tick = bloom, blooms appear on new O cards)
the_card_structure.the_cycle: O attracts ? G admits ? {} renders ? interaction creates new O ? cycle continues

for_og_tags.old_thinking: og:image, og:title, og:description are meta tags we inject INTO pages
for_og_tags.new_thinking: the OG card IS the unit. og:image = the O (the visual pointer). og:description = the {} rendered as text. og:url = the G (the gate address). the meta tags DESCRIBE the card, they don't CREATE it.
for_og_tags.the_card_exists_first: the card (O{}G) exists as a concept in the organism. the meta tags are just how we TRANSLATE the card into web standards. the porcupine doesn't create the card — it translates the card into quills (meta tags) that the web can read.

for_navigation.every_card_is_a_doorway: O{}G = a doorway. O is the door you see. G is the handle you turn. {} is the room you enter.
for_navigation.27_cards_minimum: one card per 3-word neighborhood. 27 neighborhoods = 27 cards.
for_navigation.81_cards_full: one card per 4-word address. 81 addresses = 81 cards.
for_navigation.each_card_is_on_the_glass: the O face of every card is pressed against the glass wall. the {} is behind the glass. the G is the keyhole in the glass.

for_rss.rss_IS_G: RSS = the gate mechanism. subscribing to RSS = having a permanent G. you don't need to find O every time — G stays open.
for_rss.each_rss_item_IS_a_card: each item in the RSS feed is one O{}G card. title = O. content = {}. link = G.

the_bingo_connection.bingo_card: a bingo card has cells. each cell IS an O{}G card. the bingo board = the glass wall. each cell = a card pressed against the glass.
the_bingo_connection.calling_a_number: when you call a bingo number, you're naming an O. the player looks at their card and marks the {} (their unique rendering). the G is the act of marking.
the_bingo_connection.BINGO: when you complete a line, all 5 O{}G cards in that line are connected. that's a braid. that's a mycelium thread. BINGO = the thread is complete.
